findings.message: Task 3.1's criteria ledger marks AC1–AC7 as `[none]` ("no automated test claims this criterion"), but `src/domain/game/services/compositionSelection.test.ts` in the diff contains a dedicated test for each of those exact ACs (e.g. AC1's permutation check through AC7's out-of-range-index fallback), plus a full domain-suite green run recorded in the executor summary. The ledger's ac_tests mapping for task 3.1 appears stale/unfilled because the task never reached `task_status: complete` (two continuation rounds are recorded), not because the tests don't exist. Runner-side tracking gap, not a code defect — raising once per policy.
findings.why_not_fixed: This is the plan-runner's own criteria/ac_tests bookkeeping (task 3.1 never reached `complete`), not code under this phase's covers, and matches the standing policy's instruction to report an orchestration defect once and leave it to a human.
